name: wight
languages: the languages it knew in life

actions.name: multiattack
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} makes two [[/item .WZ3XGh48UoyAvBhS]]{longsword} attacks or two [[/item .PUYwkzEiKopyM6YL]]{longbow} attacks. It can use its [[/item .NX8cqG6aZMns8wvY]]{Life Drain} in place of one longsword attack.

actions.name: longsword
actions.desc: [[/attack extended]]. [[/damage extended]], or [[/damage average attackMode=twoHanded]] damage if used with two hands.

actions.name: life drain
actions.desc: [[/attack extended]]. [[/damage extended]]. The target must succeed on a [[/save]] saving throw or its hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the damage taken. This reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if this effect reduces its hit point maximum to 0. A humanoid slain by this attack rises 24 hours later as a @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.monsters.Actor.NAISFPoNNgUCsEyW]{zombie} under the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s control, unless the humanoid is restored to life or its body is destroyed. The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can have no more than twelve zombies under its control at one time.

actions.name: sunlight sensitivity
actions.desc: While in sunlight, the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.
